change: Drafting tools checked against ET 2017 tool by tool and aligned with it; 21 panel tools and 42 validated commands (right-angle connection, lines between division points, perpendicular and tangent from a point, end move, vertical and horizontal correction, curve point editing); curves keep their points in the ET PRJ; the assistant asks once whether bare numbers are centimetres or inches and reads inch fractions. Includes v48 (first drafting tools, multi-point curve).
validation: Node tests, 12 real-browser suites, the same input run in ET 2017 and in the page for ten tools and for the end move of a curve, and an ET 2017 round trip of the drafting file made in the browser: open, unchanged re-save, native save/reopen, new line, save/reopen three times
limits: No measuring commands yet; fillet, corner join and length change apply to loose straight lines only; a PRJ without pieces can be written and opened by ET but not reopened by this page; no model service is included and no key is shipped; drafting from measurements covers the straight-pants demonstration rules, which await patternmaker review
